verdict.rationale: Atlas is a startup legal-document platform, so e-signature is a fair axis. The only relevant evidence is that founders can create, send, and track SAFEs from the Dashboard using Cooley-developed templates, which implies a send-for-signature flow for one document type. Missing for 10: explicit legally binding e-signature documentation, sending arbitrary documents, multi-recipient sending, signing order/routing, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
